name.value: Lac Des Roches Resort & Italian Restaurant

description.value: A full-service lakefront resort and Italian restaurant on Highway 24 (The Fishing Highway) near Lone Butte, BC, open year-round and set on 47 acres beside one of British Columbia's most photographed lakes. The Italian restaurant features northern Italian chefs preparing fresh entrees daily, offering a distinctive sit-down dining option along this rural cycling corridor. The resort is widely known among anglers for trophy Gerrard Rainbow trout fishing, and the surrounding area provides access to over 100 lakes within an hour's drive.
